description: Fix infra/docker-compose.yml permanently: add NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 environment to the api service, remove the healthcheck block from api, and simplify depends_on for nginx to just '- api' without condition: service_healthy.
steps: Edit infra/docker-compose.yml: Add environment section to 'api' service with NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0
Remove the entire healthcheck block from the 'api' service
Change nginx depends_on from 'api: condition: service_healthy' to just '- api' (simple list format)
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose.yml api service has environment: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0
docker-compose.yml api service has NO healthcheck section
docker-compose.yml nginx depends_on is a simple list ['api'] without condition
verification: Run: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml config 2>&1 to validate YAML syntax
findings: docker compose CLI not available in sandbox so validated YAML with Python yaml.safe_load and assertions instead. All three changes verified: environment added, healthcheck removed, depends_on simplified.
